translations.literal: Previously, the Jiaozhi Di tribesman Zhang Pokan fled to escape punishment; Prefect of Qin Prefecture Mu Chongying summoned him, but halfway there he was refused again; Metropolitan Inspector Zang Si then ordered Ruhong Stockade to treat him with oxen and wine as hospitality.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, the Jiaozhi Di tribesman Zhang Pokan had fled to escape punishment. Mu Chongying, Prefect of Qin Prefecture, summoned him, but halfway there he was refused again. Metropolitan Inspector Zang Si then ordered Ruhong Stockade to treat him with oxen and wine in hospitality.

sentences.zh: 交州偵知其事，因捕狄獠，故鈔如洪砦，掠人畜甚衆。

translations.literal: Jiaozhi learned of this and therefore captured Di tribesmen; on that pretext raided Ruhong Stockade and plundered very many people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaozhi learned of this, captured Di tribesmen, and on that pretext raided Ruhong Stockade, plundering a great many people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 詔轉運司督公蘊追索，仍令疆吏自今不得誘召蠻獠致生事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the transport commission to supervise Gongyun in demanding restitution, and ordered frontier officials henceforth not to entice or summon barbarian tribesmen so as to cause incidents.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the transport commission to supervise Gongyun in demanding restitution, and ordered frontier officials henceforth not to entice or summon barbarian tribesmen and thereby cause incidents.

sentences.zh: 公蘊或間歲或仍歲以方物入貢。

translations.literal: Gongyun sent tribute of local products either every other year or every year.
translations.idiomatic: Gongyun sent tribute of local products either every other year or every year.

sentences.zh: 天禧元年，進封公蘊南平王，加食邑一千戶，實封四百戶。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianxi, Gongyun was advanced to Prince of Nanping, with an additional fief of one thousand households and an actual fief of four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Tianxi era, Gongyun was promoted to Prince of Nanping, his fief increased by one thousand households, and his actual fief set at four hundred households.

sentences.zh: 三年，加檢校太尉，食邑一千戶，實封四百戶。

translations.literal: In the third year, he was given Acting Grand Commandant; fief one thousand households, actual fief four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was given the title Acting Grand Commandant, with a fief of one thousand households and an actual fief of four hundred.

sentences.zh: 每加恩皆遣使將命至其境上，仍賜器幣、襲衣、金帶、鞍馬焉。

translations.literal: Each time favor was added, envoys were dispatched bearing imperial command to the border of his territory, and he was further bestowed ritual vessels and silks, ceremonial robes, gold belts, and saddled horses.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever new honors were conferred, envoys were sent to deliver the imperial decree at his frontier, and he was further granted ritual vessels and silks, ceremonial robes, a gold belt, and saddled horses.

sentences.zh: 仁宗即位，加公蘊檢校太師。

translations.literal: When Renzong ascended the throne, Gongyun was given Acting Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Renzong took the throne, Gongyun was appointed Acting Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 遣長州刺史李寬泰、都護副使阮守疆來貢。

translations.literal: He sent Prefect of Chang Prefecture Li Kuantai and Vice Deputy Protector General Ruan Shoujiang with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Li Kuantai, prefect of Chang Prefecture, and Ruan Shoujiang, vice deputy protector general, to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 天聖六年，遣歡州刺史李公顯來貢，除敘州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tiansheng, he sent Prefect of Huan Prefecture Li Gongxian with tribute; Li was appointed Prefect of Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Tiansheng he sent Li Gongxian, prefect of Huan Prefecture, with tribute; Li was then appointed prefect of Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 既而令其子弟及其婿申承貴率衆內寇，詔廣南西路轉運司發溪峒丁壯討捕之。

translations.literal: Soon after, he had his sons and younger kinsmen and his son-in-law Shen Chenggui lead a crowd in raiding inward; an edict ordered the Guangnan West Circuit transport commission to mobilize stalwart men from stream gorges and cave settlements to pursue and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he had his sons, younger relatives, and his son-in-law Shen Chenggui lead a band in raiding across the border. An edict ordered the Guangnan West Circuit transport commission to raise stalwart men from the stream gorges and cave settlements to hunt them down.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒，年四十四。

translations.literal: Before long he died, at age forty-four.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died, at the age of forty-four.

sentences.zh: 其子德政自稱權知留後事，來告哀。

translations.literal: His son Dezheng styled himself Acting Military Governor and came to report the bereavement.
translations.idiomatic: His son Dezheng declared himself Acting Military Governor and came to announce his father's death.

sentences.zh: 贈公蘊爲侍中、南越王，命本路轉運使王惟正爲祭奠使，又爲賜官告使。

translations.literal: Gongyun was posthumously given Palace Attendant and King of Nanyue; the circuit transport commissioner Wang Weizheng was appointed condolence envoy, and also envoy to bestow the patent of office.
translations.idiomatic: Gongyun was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant and King of Nanyue. The circuit transport commissioner Wang Weizheng was appointed condolence envoy and also envoy to deliver the patent of appointment.

sentences.zh: 除德政檢校太尉、靜海軍節度使、安南都護、交趾郡王。

translations.literal: Dezheng was appointed Acting Grand Commandant, Military Commissioner of the Jinghai Army, Protector General of Annan, and King of Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: Dezheng was appointed Acting Grand Commandant, military commissioner of the Jinghai Army, protector general of Annan, and enfeoffed as King of Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 天聖九年，遣知峰州刺史李偓佺、知愛州刺史帥日新等來謝，以偓佺爲歡州刺史、日新爲珍州刺史。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Tiansheng, he sent Prefect of Feng Prefecture Li Wotian and Prefect of Ai Prefecture Shuai Rixin and others to present thanks; Wotian was made Prefect of Huan Prefecture and Rixin Prefect of Zhen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Tiansheng he sent Li Wotian, prefect of Feng Prefecture, and Shuai Rixin, prefect of Ai Prefecture, among others, to present thanks. Wotian was made prefect of Huan Prefecture and Rixin prefect of Zhen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 明道元年，恭謝，加同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Mingdao, in presenting thanks he was given Acting Chief Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Mingdao, while presenting thanks he was given the title Acting Chief Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 景祐中，郡人陳公永等六百餘人內附，德政遣兵千餘境上捕逐之。

translations.literal: During Jingyou, more than six hundred local people led by Chen Gongyong submitted inward; Dezheng sent more than a thousand troops to the border to hunt and drive them back.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jingyou era, more than six hundred local people led by Chen Gongyong submitted to the Song. Dezheng sent over a thousand troops to the border to hunt them down and drive them back.

sentences.zh: 詔遣還，仍戒德政毋得輒誅殺。

translations.literal: An edict ordered them sent back, and warned Dezheng not to kill them at will.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the people returned and warned Dezheng that he must not kill them at will.

sentences.zh: 尋遣靜海軍節度判官陳應機、掌書記王惟慶來貢，以應機爲太子中允、惟慶爲大理寺丞，德政加檢校太師。

translations.literal: Soon after, Jinghai Army adjutant Chen Yingji and senior secretary Wang Weiqing came with tribute; Yingji was made Vice Director of the Crown Prince's Household and Weiqing Assistant Director of the Court of Judicial Review; Dezheng was given Acting Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, Jinghai Army adjutant Chen Yingji and senior secretary Wang Weiqing arrived with tribute. Yingji was made vice director in the Crown Prince's household and Weiqing assistant director of the Court of Judicial Review, while Dezheng was given Acting Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 三年，其甲峒及諒州、門州、蘇茂州、廣源州、大發峒、丹波縣蠻寇邕州之思陵州、西平州、石西州及諸峒，略居人馬牛，焚室廬而去。

translations.literal: In the third year, the Jiadong and barbarians of Liang Prefecture, Men Prefecture, Sumao Prefecture, Guangyuan Prefecture, the Dafa Dong, and Danbo County raided Silin Prefecture, Xiping Prefecture, Shixi Prefecture, and various dong settlements under Yong Prefecture, carried off people, horses, and cattle, burned dwellings, and departed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, the Jiadong together with tribes of Liang, Men, Sumao, and Guangyuan prefectures, the Dafa Dong, and Danbo County raided Silin, Xiping, and Shixi prefectures and various dong settlements under Yong Prefecture, carrying off people, horses, and cattle, burning dwellings, and withdrawing.

sentences.zh: 下詔責問之，且令捕酋首正其罪以聞。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked and questioned him, and ordered that ringleaders be captured and their crimes adjudicated and reported.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial edict rebuked and questioned him, ordering that tribal leaders be captured, their crimes properly punished, and the results reported.

sentences.zh: 寶元元年，進封南平王。

translations.literal: In the first year of Baoyuan, he was promoted to Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoyuan he was promoted to Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 康定元年，遣知峰州刺史帥用和、節度副使杜猶興等來貢。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangding, he sent Prefect of Feng Prefecture Shuai Yonghe, Vice Military Commissioner Du Youxing, and others with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kangding he sent Shuai Yonghe, prefect of Feng Prefecture, Du Youxing, vice military commissioner, and others with tribute.

sentences.zh: 慶曆三年，又遣節度副使杜慶安、三班奉職梁材來，以慶安爲順州刺史、材爲太子左監門率府率。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qingli, he again sent Vice Military Commissioner Du Qing'an and Third-Rank Attendant Liang Cai; Qing'an was made Prefect of Shun Prefecture and Cai Colonel of the Left Gate Guard of the Crown Prince's Household.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Qingli he again sent vice military commissioner Du Qing'an and third-rank attendant Liang Cai. Qing'an was made prefect of Shun Prefecture and Cai colonel of the Left Gate Guard in the Crown Prince's household.

sentences.zh: 六年，又遣兵部員外郎蘇仁祚、東頭供奉官陶惟�来，以仁祚爲工部郎中、惟�爲內殿崇班。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he again sent Vice Director of the Ministry of War Su Renzuo and Eastern Head Palace Attendant Tao Weizhong; Renzuo was made Director in the Ministry of Works and Tao was given Inner Hall Honored Band.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he again sent Su Renzuo, vice director in the Ministry of War, and Tao Weizhong, eastern head palace attendant. Renzuo was made director in the Ministry of Works and Tao was given Inner Hall Honored Band.

sentences.zh: 明年，又遣秘書丞杜文府、左侍禁文昌來，以文府爲屯田員外郎、昌爲內殿崇班。

translations.literal: The next year, he again sent Secretariat Assistant Director Du Wenfu and Left Attendant Guard Wenchang; Wenfu was made Vice Director of the Directorate of Agriculture and Chang Inner Hall Honored Band.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he again sent Du Wenfu, assistant director of the Secretariat, and Wenchang, a left attendant guard. Wenfu was made vice director of the directorate of agriculture and Wenchang Inner Hall Honored Band.

sentences.zh: 初，德政發兵取占城，朝廷疑其內畜奸謀，乃訪自唐以來所通道路凡十六處，令轉運使杜杞度其要害而戍守之，然其後亦未嘗寇邊。

translations.literal: Initially, Dezheng raised troops to seize Champa; the court suspected he harbored treacherous designs within, therefore investigated all routes of communication since the Tang—sixteen places in all—and ordered transport commissioner Du Qi to assess their strategic points and garrison them; nevertheless, afterward he never again raided the border.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Dezheng had raised troops to seize Champa. The court suspected he was harboring treacherous designs and therefore mapped every route open since Tang times—sixteen in all—ordering transport commissioner Du Qi to identify key points and post garrisons. Even so, he never again raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 前後累貢馴象。

translations.literal: Repeatedly, over the years, he sent tribute of trained elephants.
translations.idiomatic: Over the years he repeatedly sent trained elephants as tribute.

sentences.zh: 皇祐二年，邕州誘其蘇茂州韋紹嗣、紹欽等三千余人入居省地，德政表求所誘。

translations.literal: In the second year of Huangyou, Yong Prefecture enticed more than three thousand people from Sumao Prefecture—Wei Shaosi, Shaoqin, and others—to settle on imperial territory; Dezheng memorialized demanding those who had been enticed back.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Huangyou, Yong Prefecture enticed more than three thousand people from Sumao Prefecture, including Wei Shaosi and Shaoqin, to settle on Song territory. Dezheng memorialized demanding their return.

sentences.zh: 詔盡還之，仍令德政約束邊戶，毋相侵犯。

translations.literal: An edict ordered all returned, and commanded Dezheng to restrain his border households from mutual encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that all be returned and instructed Dezheng to restrain his border households from mutual raids.

sentences.zh: 其後，廣源州蠻儂智高反，德政率兵二萬由水路欲入助王師，朝廷優其賜而卻其兵。

translations.literal: Afterward, the Guangyuan Prefecture barbarian Nong Zhigao rebelled; Dezheng led twenty thousand troops by water route wishing to enter and aid the imperial army; the court enriched his gifts but declined his troops.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when the Guangyuan chieftain Nong Zhigao rebelled, Dezheng led twenty thousand men by water, intending to join the imperial campaign. The court heaped gifts upon him but refused his troops.

sentences.zh: 至和二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhihe, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhihe he died.

sentences.zh: 其子日尊遣人告哀，命廣南西路轉運使、尚書屯田員外郎蘇安世爲吊贈使，贈德政爲侍中、南越王，賻齎甚厚。

translations.literal: His son Rizun sent persons to report the bereavement; Guangnan West Circuit transport commissioner and Vice Director of Agriculture in the Ministry of Revenue Su Anshi was appointed condolence and gift envoy; Dezheng was posthumously given Palace Attendant and King of Nanyue, with very generous funeral gifts.
translations.idiomatic: His son Rizun sent envoys to announce the death. Su Anshi, Guangnan West Circuit transport commissioner and vice director of agriculture in the Ministry of Revenue, was appointed condolence envoy. Dezheng was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant and King of Nanyue, with lavish funeral gifts.

sentences.zh: 尋除日尊特進、檢校太尉、靜海軍節度使、安南都護，封交趾郡王。

translations.literal: Soon Rizun was appointed Special Grandee, Acting Grand Commandant, Military Commissioner of the Jinghai Army, Protector General of Annan, and enfeoffed King of Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: Rizun was soon appointed Special Grandee, Acting Grand Commandant, military commissioner of the Jinghai Army, protector general of Annan, and enfeoffed as King of Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐三年，貢異獸二。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiayou, he sent tribute of two exotic beasts.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiayou he sent two exotic beasts as tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年，寇欽州思稟管。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he raided Sibingguan in Qin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he raided Sibingguan in Qin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五年，與甲峒賊寇邕州，詔知桂州蕭固發部兵與轉運使宋鹹、提點刑獄李師中同議掩擊；

translations.literal: In the fifth year, together with Jiadong bandits he raided Yong Prefecture; an edict ordered Prefect of Gui Prefecture Xiao Gu to raise local troops and, together with transport commissioner Song Xian and Judicial Intendant Li Shizhong, jointly plan a surprise attack;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined Jiadong bandits in raiding Yong Prefecture. An edict ordered Xiao Gu, prefect of Gui Prefecture, to mobilize local troops and, together with transport commissioner Song Xian and judicial intendant Li Shizhong, plan a surprise attack;

sentences.zh: 又詔安撫使余靖等發兵捕討。

translations.literal: Another edict ordered Pacification Commissioner Yu Jing and others to raise troops to pursue and subdue them.
translations.idiomatic: another edict ordered pacification commissioner Yu Jing and others to raise troops and pursue them.

sentences.zh: 靖遣諜誘占城同廣南西路兵甲趨交趾，日尊惶怖，上表待罪。

translations.literal: Jing sent spies to induce Champa to join Guangnan West Circuit forces in marching on Jiaozhi; Rizun was terrified and submitted a memorial awaiting punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Jing sent agents to induce Champa to join Guangnan West Circuit forces in marching on Jiaozhi. Rizun was terrified and submitted a memorial awaiting punishment.

sentences.zh: 詔未得舉兵，聽日尊貢奉至京師。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that no troops be raised; Rizun was permitted to send tribute to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade mobilization and permitted Rizun to continue sending tribute to the capital.

sentences.zh: 八年，遣文思使梅景先、副使大理評事李繼先貢馴象九。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he sent Document Artisan Commissioner Mei Jingxian and Vice-envoy Assessor of the Court of Judicial Review Li Jixian with nine trained elephants as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he sent document artisan commissioner Mei Jingxian and vice-envoy Li Jixian, an assessor of the Court of Judicial Review, with nine trained elephants as tribute.

sentences.zh: 四月戊寅，以大行皇帝詔及遺留物賜日尊，加同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin of the fourth month, the late emperor's edict and remaining possessions were bestowed on Rizun, and he was given Acting Chief Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the fourth month, the late emperor's edict and remaining gifts were bestowed on Rizun, who was also given Acting Chief Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 是日，交趾使辭，命內侍省押班李繼和喻以申紹泰入寇，本路屢乞討伐，而朝廷以紹泰一夫肆狂，又本道已遣使謝罪，故未欲興兵。

translations.literal: That same day, as the Jiaozhi envoy took leave, Palace Inner Service Controller Li Jihe was ordered to explain regarding Shen Shaotai's border raid: the circuit had repeatedly begged for punitive action, but the court considered Shaotai a lone man running wild, and the circuit had already sent envoys to apologize, so it did not yet wish to raise armies.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, as the Jiaozhi envoy took his leave, Li Jihe, controller of the Palace Inner Service, was ordered to explain that although the circuit had repeatedly requested a punitive campaign over Shen Shaotai's raid, the court regarded Shaotai as one man run amok and the circuit had already sent envoys to apologize, and so did not yet wish to raise troops.

sentences.zh: 治平初，知桂州陸詵言，交州來求儂宗旦男日新及欲取溫悶洞等地，帝問交趾于何年割據，輔臣對曰：「自唐至德中改安南都護府，梁貞明中，土豪曲承美專有此地。」

translations.literal: Early in Zhiping, Prefect of Gui Prefecture Lu Shen reported that Jiaozhi had come seeking Nong Zongdan's son Rixin and wishing to take Wendong Cave and other lands; the Emperor asked in what year Jiaozhi had carved out independent territory; a privy counselor replied: "From the Tang, in the Zhongde era when the Annan Protectorate was renamed; in the Zhenming era of Liang, local magnate Qu Chengmei exclusively held this land."
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhiping era, Lu Shen, prefect of Gui Prefecture, reported that Jiaozhi had come seeking Nong Zongdan's son Rixin and wished to recover Wendong Cave and other territory. The emperor asked when Jiaozhi had first carved out its own domain. A privy counselor replied, "From Tang times: in the Zhongde era the Annan Protectorate was reorganized, and in the Zhenming era of Liang the local magnate Qu Chengmei came to hold this land exclusively."

sentences.zh: 韓琦曰：「向以黎桓叛命，太宗遣將討伐，不服，後遣使詔誘，始效順。

translations.literal: Han Qi said: "Formerly because Li Huan rebelled against imperial command, Taizong dispatched generals to chastise him; he would not submit; afterward envoys were sent to entice him with edicts, and only then did he show obedience.
translations.idiomatic: Han Qi said, "Formerly Li Huan defied imperial command. Emperor Taizong sent generals to chastise him, but he would not submit. Only after envoys were sent with edicts to win him over did he show obedience.

sentences.zh: 交州山路險僻，多潦霧瘴毒之氣，雖得其地，恐不能守也。」

translations.literal: The mountain roads of Jiaozhi are perilous and remote, with much miasma and poisonous vapors; even if we gained the territory, I fear we could not hold it."
translations.idiomatic: The mountain roads of Jiaozhi are perilous and remote, thick with miasma and poisonous vapors. Even if we took the land, I fear we could not hold it."

sentences.zh: 神宗即位，進封日尊南平王。

translations.literal: When Shenzong ascended the throne, Rizun was promoted to Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shenzong took the throne, Rizun was promoted to Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 熙甯元年，加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xining, he was given Grand Preceptor with Honors Equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xining he was given the title Grand Preceptor with Honors Equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 二年，表言：「占城國久闕貢，臣親帥兵討之，虜其王。」

translations.literal: In the second year, he memorialized: "Champa has long failed in tribute; I personally led troops to chastise them and captured their king."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he memorialized, "Champa has long neglected tribute. I personally led troops against them and captured their king."

sentences.zh: 詔以其使郭士安爲六宅副使、陶宗元爲內殿崇班。

translations.literal: An edict made his envoy Guo Shi'an Vice Commissioner of the Six Residences and Tao Zongyuan Inner Hall Honored Band.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed his envoys Guo Shi'an vice commissioner of the Six Residences and Tao Zongyuan Inner Hall Honored Band.

sentences.zh: 日尊自帝其國，僭稱法天應運崇仁至道慶成龍祥英武睿文尊德聖神皇帝，尊公蘊爲太祖神武皇帝，國號大越，改元寶象，又改神武。

translations.literal: Rizun declared himself emperor of his realm, presumptuously styling himself Emperor Corresponding to Heaven, Upholding Fate, Cherishing Benevolence, Utmost Way, Celebrating Success, Dragon Auspice, Heroic Martial, Sagacious Literary, Revered Virtue, Sage Spirit; he honored Gongyun as Martial Spirit Taizu Emperor; the state name was Great Yue; he changed the era name to Baoxiang, then again to Shenwu.
translations.idiomatic: Rizun declared himself emperor of his own realm, presumptuously taking the title Emperor Corresponding to Heaven, Upholding Fate, Cherishing Benevolence, Utmost Way, Celebrating Success, Dragon Auspice, Heroic Martial, Sagacious Literary, Revered Virtue, Sage Spirit. He honored Gongyun as Martial Spirit Taizu Emperor, named his state Great Yue, and changed the era name first to Baoxiang and then to Shenwu.

sentences.zh: 五年三月，日尊卒。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifth year, Rizun died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifth year Rizun died.

sentences.zh: 命廣西轉運使康衛爲吊贈使。

translations.literal: Guangxi transport commissioner Kang Wei was appointed condolence and gift envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Wei, Guangxi transport commissioner, was appointed condolence envoy.

sentences.zh: 予所奪州縣。

translations.literal: Restoration of the prefectures and counties that were taken from me.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized requesting restoration of the prefectures and counties that had been seized from him.

sentences.zh: 詔報之曰：「卿撫有南交，世受王爵，而乃背德奸命，竊暴邊城。

translations.literal: An edict replied: "You hold sway over the southern frontier, generation after generation receiving royal enfeoffment, yet you turned against virtue and betrayed command, stealthily ravaging border cities.
translations.idiomatic: An edict in reply said, "You govern the southern frontier and for generations have received royal enfeoffment, yet you turned against virtue, defied command, and stealthily ravaged our border towns.

sentences.zh: 棄祖考忠順之圖，煩朝廷討伐之舉。

translations.literal: You abandoned your forebears' design of loyalty and submission, troubling the court with punitive campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: You cast aside your ancestors' path of loyalty and submission and forced the court into punitive campaigns.

sentences.zh: 師行深入，勢蹙始歸。

translations.literal: When our armies advanced deep into your territory, only when pressed to extremity did you return to obedience.
translations.idiomatic: Only when our armies marched deep into your lands and you were driven to extremity did you return to obedience.

sentences.zh: 跡其罪尤，在所絀削。

translations.literal: Tracing the gravity of your crimes, reductions are everywhere warranted.
translations.idiomatic: Given the weight of your offenses, reductions everywhere are warranted.

sentences.zh: 今遣使修貢，上章致恭，詳觀詞情，灼見悛悔。

translations.literal: Now you send envoys to resume tribute and submit memorials of respect; examining your words closely, I clearly see repentance.
translations.idiomatic: Now you send envoys to resume tribute and submit respectful memorials. Reading your words closely, I clearly see repentance.

sentences.zh: 朕撫綏萬國，不異邇遐。

translations.literal: I put all nations at ease without distinction between near and far.
translations.idiomatic: I soothe all nations alike, making no distinction between near and far.

sentences.zh: 但以邕、欽之民，遷劫炎陬，久失鄉井，俟盡送還省界，即以廣源等賜交州。」

translations.literal: But as for the people of Yong and Qin, carried off in raids to the sultry south and long deprived of their native villages—once they are all sent back within the provincial border, Guangyuan and the rest will be granted to Jiaozhi."
translations.idiomatic: But the people of Yong and Qin, carried off in raids to the sultry south and long separated from their homes, must first all be returned within the provincial border; then Guangyuan and the rest will be granted to Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 乾德初約歸三州官吏千人，久之，才送民二百二十一口，男子年十五以上皆刺額曰「天子兵」，二十以上曰「投南朝」，婦人刺左手曰「官客」。

translations.literal: Gande had initially agreed to return a thousand officials and subjects from the three prefectures; after a long time, he sent back only two hundred twenty-one common people; males fifteen and above were tattooed on the forehead "Soldiers of the Son of Heaven"; those twenty and above "Defected to the Southern Court"; women tattooed on the left hand "Official guests."
translations.idiomatic: Gande had initially agreed to return a thousand officials and subjects from the three prefectures, but after a long delay sent back only two hundred twenty-one commoners. Males fifteen and older were tattooed on the forehead "Soldiers of the Son of Heaven"; those twenty and older, "Defected to the Southern Court"; women were tattooed on the left hand "Official guests."

sentences.zh: 以舟載之而泥其戶牖，中設燈燭，日行一二十里則止，而偽作更鼓以報，凡數月乃至，蓋以紿示海道之遠也。

translations.literal: They were carried by boat with their doors and windows sealed with mud; lamps and candles were set inside; they proceeded only ten or twenty li per day and then stopped, and false watch-drums were beaten to signal the hours—it took several months to arrive—deceiving them to show how far the sea route was.
translations.idiomatic: They were transported by boat with doors and windows sealed in mud, lamps and candles lit inside. They moved only ten or twenty li a day before halting, while false watch-drums were beaten to mark the hours. It took months to arrive—a ruse to make the sea route seem impossibly long.

sentences.zh: 順州落南深，置戍鎮守，被罹瘴霧多病沒，陶弼亦終於官。

translations.literal: Shun Prefecture lay deep in the southern hinterland; garrisons were posted to guard it, but many succumbed to miasma and disease; Tao Bi also died in office there.
translations.idiomatic: Shun Prefecture lay deep in the southern interior. Posted garrisons suffered heavily from miasma and disease, and Tao Bi too died in office there.

sentences.zh: 朝廷知其無用，乃悉以四州一縣還之。

translations.literal: The court knew it was useless and therefore returned all four prefectures and one county to them.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing the posts were useless, the court returned all four prefectures and one county to them.

sentences.zh: 然廣源舊隸邕管羈縻，本非交趾所有也。

translations.literal: Yet Guangyuan had formerly been under Yong Prefecture's indirect rule and had never belonged to Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Guangyuan had long been under Yong Prefecture's indirect administration and had never truly belonged to Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 元豐五年，獻馴象二、犀角象齒百。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yuanfeng, he presented two trained elephants and a hundred items of rhinoceros horn and ivory.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Yuanfeng he presented two trained elephants and a hundred pieces of rhinoceros horn and ivory.

sentences.zh: 六年，以追捕儂智會爲辭，犯歸化州。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, on the pretext of pursuing Nong Zhihui, he violated Guihua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the pretext of pursuing Nong Zhihui, he violated Guihua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又遣其臣黎文盛來廣西辦理順安、歸化境界，經略使熊本遣左江巡檢成卓與議，文盛稱陪臣，不敢爭執。

translations.literal: He also sent his minister Li Wensheng to Guangxi to settle the boundaries of Shun'an and Guihua; Military Commissioner Xiong Ben dispatched Left River Inspector Cheng Zhuo to negotiate with him; Wensheng styled himself a subordinate minister and dared not dispute.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent his minister Li Wensheng to Guangxi to settle the Shun'an and Guihua boundaries. Military commissioner Xiong Ben dispatched Left River inspector Cheng Zhuo to negotiate with him. Wensheng styled himself a subordinate minister and dared not press his claims.

sentences.zh: 詔以文盛能遵乾德恭順之意，賜之袍帶及絹五百匹。

translations.literal: An edict, because Wensheng could follow Gande's intent of respectful submission, bestowed on him robes, belts, and five hundred bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised Wensheng for following Gande's intent of respectful submission and bestowed on him robes, a belt, and five hundred bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 仍以八隘之外保樂六縣、宿桑二峒予乾德。

translations.literal: Beyond the eight passes, Baole's six counties and Susang's two dong were still granted to Gande.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the eight passes, the six counties of Baole and the two dong of Susang were also granted to Gande.

sentences.zh: 哲宗立，加同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: When Zhezong ascended the throne, he was given Acting Chief Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhezong took the throne, Gande was given Acting Chief Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 元祐中，又數上表求勿惡、勿陽峒地，詔不許。

translations.literal: During Yuanyou, he repeatedly memorialized seeking the Wue and Wuyang dong lands; an edict refused.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanyou era he repeatedly memorialized seeking the Wue and Wuyang dong territories, but an edict refused.

sentences.zh: 二年，遣使入貢，進封南平王。

translations.literal: In the second year, he sent envoys with tribute and was promoted to Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he sent envoys with tribute and was promoted to Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 徽宗時，累加開府儀同三司、檢校太師。

translations.literal: During Huizong's reign, he was repeatedly given Grand Preceptor with Honors Equal to the Three Excellencies and Acting Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: During Emperor Huizong's reign he was repeatedly given Grand Preceptor with Honors Equal to the Three Excellencies and Acting Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 大觀初，貢使至京乞市書籍，有司言法不許，詔嘉其慕義，除禁書、卜筮、陰陽、曆算、術數、兵書、敕令、時務、邊機、地理外，余書許買。

translations.literal: Early in Daguan, tribute envoys reaching the capital requested to purchase books; the relevant offices said the law did not permit it; an edict praised their admiration of righteousness: apart from prohibited books, divination, yin-yang lore, calendrical calculation, numerology, military texts, edicts, current affairs, frontier secrets, and geography, the remainder of books were permitted for purchase.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Daguan era, tribute envoys reaching the capital asked to buy books. The relevant offices said the law forbade it, but an edict praised their love of learning: aside from prohibited books, divination, yin-yang lore, calendrical and numerological works, military texts, edicts, current affairs, frontier secrets, and geography, all other books might be purchased.

sentences.zh: 政和末，又詔以交人自熙甯以來，全不生事，特寬和市之禁。

translations.literal: Late in Zhenghe, another edict stated that since the Jiaozhi people had since Xining entirely refrained from causing trouble, the restrictions on mutual market trade were specially relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Zhenghe era another edict declared that, since the people of Jiaozhi had since Xining caused no trouble at all, restrictions on mutual market trade were specially relaxed.

sentences.zh: 宣和元年，加乾德守司空。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuanhe, Gande was given Acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuanhe Gande was given the title Acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 建炎元年，詔廣西經略安撫司禁邊民毋受安南逋逃，從其主乾德之請也。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianyan, an edict ordered the Guangxi Military Commission and Pacification Office to forbid border peoples from accepting fugitives from Annan—accord with their ruler Gande's request.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianyan an edict ordered the Guangxi military commission and pacification office to forbid border people from sheltering fugitives from Annan, acceding to their ruler Gande's request.

sentences.zh: 四年，安南入貢，詔卻其方物之華靡者，賜敕書，厚其報以懷柔之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Annan sent tribute; an edict declined their lavish exotic goods, bestowed an imperial letter, and enriched the return gifts to win them over.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Annan sent tribute. An edict declined their most lavish gifts, bestowed an imperial letter, and enriched the return gifts as a gesture of conciliation.

sentences.zh: 紹興二年，乾德卒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoxing, Gande died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shaoxing Gande died.

sentences.zh: 贈侍中，追封南越王。

translations.literal: Posthumously given Palace Attendant; posthumously enfeoffed King of Nanyue.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant and posthumously enfeoffed as King of Nanyue.

sentences.zh: 子陽煥嗣，授靜海軍節度使、特進、檢校太尉，封交趾郡王，賜推誠順化功臣。

translations.literal: Son Yang Huan succeeded; appointed Military Commissioner of Jinghai Army, Special Grandee, Acting Grand Commandant, enfeoffed King of Jiaozhi, bestowed Honorable Merit for Expelling Sincerity and Transforming Submission.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yang Huan succeeded, appointed military commissioner of the Jinghai Army, Special Grandee, and Acting Grand Commandant, enfeoffed as King of Jiaozhi, and granted Honorable Merit for Expelling Sincerity and Transforming Submission.

sentences.zh: 八年，陽煥卒，以轉運副使朱芾充弔祭使，贈陽煥開府儀同三司，追封南平王。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Yang Huan died; Vice Transport Commissioner Zhu Fei was appointed condolence envoy; Yang Huan was posthumously given Grand Preceptor with Honors Equal to the Three Excellencies and posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Yang Huan died. Vice transport commissioner Zhu Fei was appointed condolence envoy. Yang Huan was posthumously given Grand Preceptor with Honors Equal to the Three Excellencies and posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 子天祚嗣，授官如其父初封之制。

translations.literal: Son Tianzuo succeeded; offices conferred according to his father's initial enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: His son Tianzuo succeeded and was granted offices according to the terms of his father's first enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 九年，詔廣西帥司毋受趙智之入貢。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, an edict ordered the Guangxi command not to accept tribute from Zhao Zhizhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year an edict ordered the Guangxi command not to accept tribute from Zhao Zhizhi.

sentences.zh: 初，乾德有側室子奔大理，變姓名爲趙智之，自稱平王。

translations.literal: Initially, Gande had a son by a concubine who fled to Dali, changed his name to Zhao Zhizhi, and styled himself Prince of Ping.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Gande had had a son by a concubine who fled to Dali, changed his name to Zhao Zhizhi, and styled himself Prince of Ping.

sentences.zh: 聞陽煥死，大理遣歸，與天祚爭立，求入貢，欲假兵納之，帝不許。

translations.literal: Hearing Yang Huan had died, Dali sent him back; he contended with Tianzuo for the throne, sought to send tribute, and wished to borrow troops to install himself—the Emperor refused.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Huan died, Dali sent him back. He contended with Tianzuo for the throne, sought permission to send tribute, and asked to borrow Song troops to install himself. The emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 十七年，詔文思院制鞍韉以賜天祚。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, an edict ordered the Document Artisan Institute to manufacture saddles and tack to bestow on Tianzuo.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year an edict ordered the Document Artisan Institute to make saddles and tack as gifts for Tianzuo.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，累加天祚崇義懷忠保信鄉德安遠承和功臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, Tianzuo was repeatedly given Honorable Merit for Cherishing Righteousness, Cherishing Loyalty, Preserving Trust, Honoring Virtue, Pacifying the Distance, and Upholding Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Tianzuo was granted the honorary title Cherishing Righteousness, Cherishing Loyalty, Preserving Trust, Honoring Virtue, Pacifying the Distance, and Upholding Harmony.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，詔館安南使者于懷遠驛，賜宴，以彰異數。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, an edict ordered Annan envoys lodged at Huaiyuan Station, granted banquets, to mark extraordinary favor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year an edict ordered Annan envoys lodged at Huaiyuan Station and granted banquets to mark extraordinary favor.

sentences.zh: 進封天祚南平王，賜襲衣、金帶、鞍馬。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Prince of Nanping and bestowed ceremonial robes, gold belt, and saddled horse.
translations.idiomatic: Tianzuo was promoted to Prince of Nanping and granted ceremonial robes, a gold belt, and a saddled horse.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，命右司郎中汪應辰宴安南使者于玉津園。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Right Section Director Wang Yingchen was ordered to banquet Annan envoys at Yujin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year Wang Yingchen, right section director, was ordered to banquet Annan envoys at Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 八月，天祚遣李國等以金珠、沉水香、翠羽、良馬、馴象來貢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Tianzuo sent Li Guo and others with gold, pearls, agarwood, kingfisher feathers, fine horses, and trained elephants as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Tianzuo sent Li Guo and others with gold, pearls, agarwood, kingfisher feathers, fine horses, and trained elephants as tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔加天祚檢校太師，增食邑。

translations.literal: An edict added Acting Grand Mentor for Tianzuo and increased his fief.
translations.idiomatic: An edict added Acting Grand Mentor to Tianzuo's titles and increased his fief.

sentences.zh: 隆興二年，天祚遣尹子思、鄧碩儼等貢金銀、象齒、香物。

translations.literal: In the second year of Longxing, Tianzuo sent Yin Zisi, Deng Shuoyan, and others with tribute of gold, silver, ivory, and fragrant goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Longxing Tianzuo sent Yin Zisi, Deng Shuoyan, and others with gold, silver, ivory, and fragrant goods as tribute.

sentences.zh: 乾道六年，累加天祚歸仁協恭繼美遵度履正彰善功臣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Qiandao, Tianzuo was repeatedly given Honorable Merit for Returning Benevolence, Harmonious Respect, Continuing Excellence, Following Measure, Upholding Rectitude, and Manifesting Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Qiandao Tianzuo was granted the honorary title Returning Benevolence, Harmonious Respect, Continuing Excellence, Following Measure, Upholding Rectitude, and Manifesting Goodness.

sentences.zh: 帝自即位，屢卻安南貢使。

translations.literal: Since ascending the throne, the Emperor had repeatedly declined Annan tribute envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Since taking the throne the emperor had repeatedly turned away Annan tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 九年，天祚復遣尹子思、李邦正求入貢。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Tianzuo again sent Yin Zisi and Li Bangzheng seeking permission to send tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Tianzuo again sent Yin Zisi and Li Bangzheng to request permission to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其誠，許之，詔館於懷遠驛。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised their sincerity and granted it; an edict ordered lodging at Huaiyuan Station.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised their sincerity and granted the request, ordering them lodged at Huaiyuan Station.

sentences.zh: 廣南西路經略安撫使范成大言：「本司經略諸蠻，安南在撫綏之內，其陪臣豈得與中國王官亢禮？

translations.literal: Guangnan West Circuit Military Commissioner and Pacification Envoy Fan Chengda said: "This office oversees the various barbarian tribes; Annan falls within our jurisdiction of soothing submission—how can their subordinate ministers presume equal ceremony with officials of the Middle Kingdom?
translations.idiomatic: Fan Chengda, Guangnan West Circuit military commissioner and pacification envoy, said, "This office oversees the various tribes; Annan falls within our jurisdiction. How can their subordinate ministers presume equal ceremony with officials of the Middle Kingdom?

sentences.zh: 政和間，貢使入境，皆庭參，不復報謁。

translations.literal: During Zhenghe, when tribute envoys entered the border, all paid court audience; no return visits were made.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenghe era, when tribute envoys entered the border they all paid court audience, and no return visits were made.

sentences.zh: 宜遵舊制，於禮爲得。」

translations.literal: The old regulations should be followed—that would be proper in ritual."
translations.idiomatic: The old regulations should be followed; that would be ritually correct.

sentences.zh: 朝廷從其請。

translations.literal: The court assented to his request.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted his request.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年二月，進封天祚安南國王，加號守謙功臣。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Chunxi, [Tianzuo] was advanced to King of Annam, with the added honorific title Loyal and Modest Merit Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of the Chunxi reign, Tianzuo was promoted to King of Annam and granted the additional honorific title Loyal and Modest Merit Minister.

sentences.zh: 二年，賜安南國印。

translations.literal: In the second year, the seal of the Kingdom of Annam was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, the court bestowed the seal of the Kingdom of Annam.

sentences.zh: 三年，賜安南國曆日。

translations.literal: In the third year, the official calendar of the Kingdom of Annam was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, the court bestowed the official calendar upon the Kingdom of Annam.

sentences.zh: 天祚卒。

translations.literal: Tianzuo died.
translations.idiomatic: Tianzuo died.

sentences.zh: 明年，子龍榦嗣位，授靜海軍節度使觀察處置等使、特進、檢校太尉兼御史大夫、上柱國，特封安南國王，加食邑；

translations.literal: The following year, his son Long Gan succeeded to the position; he was appointed Military Commissioner of the Jinghai Army with authority over observation and disposition, Special Advancement, Honorary Grand General concurrently Grand Censor, Upper Pillar of the State, specially enfeoffed as King of Annam, with an increase in fief income;
translations.idiomatic: The following year his son Long Gan succeeded him. He was appointed Military Commissioner of the Jinghai Army with authority over observation and disposition, granted Special Advancement, made Honorary Grand General and concurrent Grand Censor, named Upper Pillar of the State, specially enfeoffed as King of Annam, and given an increase in fief income;

sentences.zh: 仍賜推誠順化功臣，制曰：「即樂國以肇封，既從世襲；

translations.literal: He was also granted the title Loyal and Transforming Merit Minister. The decree stated: "Having secured the kingdom to establish his enfeoffment, and succession already following hereditary rule;
translations.idiomatic: He was also granted the title Loyal and Transforming Merit Minister. The decree read: "Having secured the kingdom to establish his enfeoffment, and succession already following hereditary rule;

sentences.zh: 極真王而錫命，何待次升？」

translations.literal: to bestow the imperial mandate upon the true king—why wait for sequential advancement?"
translations.idiomatic: to bestow the imperial mandate upon the true king—why wait for him to rise in turn?"

sentences.zh: 示殊禮也。

translations.literal: This displayed extraordinary courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: This was meant to show extraordinary courtesy.

sentences.zh: 五年，貢方物，上表稱謝。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, local products were sent as tribute, and a memorial of thanks was submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he sent tribute of local products and submitted a memorial of thanks.

sentences.zh: 九年，詔卻安南所貢象，以其無用而煩民，他物亦止受什一。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, an edict refused the elephants Annam offered in tribute, on the grounds that they were useless and a burden on the people; other goods as well were accepted only at one tenth.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year an edict refused the elephants Annam offered in tribute, deeming them useless and a burden on the people; other goods were accepted only at one tenth.

sentences.zh: 十六年，累加龍榦守義奉國履常懷德功臣。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Long Gan was cumulatively granted the additional title Merit Minister of Upholding Righteousness, Serving the State, Maintaining Constancy, and Cherishing Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Long Gan was cumulatively granted the additional title Merit Minister of Upholding Righteousness, Serving the State, Maintaining Constancy, and Cherishing Virtue.

sentences.zh: 光宗即位，奉表入貢稱賀。

translations.literal: When Emperor Guangzong ascended the throne, [Long Gan] submitted a memorial, sent tribute, and offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Guangzong ascended the throne, Long Gan submitted a memorial, sent tribute, and offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 甯宗朝，賜衣帶、器幣，累加謹度思忠濟美勤禮保節歸仁崇謙協恭功臣及食邑焉。

translations.literal: During the reign of Emperor Ningzong, robes, belts, utensils, and coins were bestowed; he was cumulatively granted the title Merit Minister of Prudent Conduct, Loyal Thought, Advancing Excellence, Diligent Ritual, Preserving Integrity, Returning to Benevolence, Honoring Modesty, and Harmonious Respect, along with increases in fief income.
translations.idiomatic: During the reign of Emperor Ningzong the court bestowed robes, belts, utensils, and coins, cumulatively granted him the title Merit Minister of Prudent Conduct, Loyal Thought, Advancing Excellence, Diligent Ritual, Preserving Integrity, Returning to Benevolence, Honoring Modesty, and Harmonious Respect, and increased his fief income.

sentences.zh: 嘉定五年，龍榦卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Jiading, Long Gan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Jiading reign, Long Gan died.

sentences.zh: 詔以廣西運判陳孔碩充弔祭使，特贈侍中。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Chen Kuo-shuo, transport commissioner of Guangxi, as condolence envoy, and specially posthumously granted [Long Gan] the title of Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Chen Kuo-shuo, transport commissioner of Guangxi, as condolence envoy and specially posthumously granted Long Gan the title of Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 依前安南國王制，以其子昊旵襲封其爵位，給賜如龍榦始封之制，仍賜推誠順化功臣。

translations.literal: Following the previous regulations for the King of Annam, his son Hao Yan inherited his rank and title; grants and bestowals followed the regulations of Long Gan's initial enfeoffment, and he was again granted the title Loyal and Transforming Merit Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Following the previous regulations for the King of Annam, his son Hao Yan inherited his rank and title; grants and bestowals followed those given at Long Gan's initial enfeoffment, and he was again granted the title Loyal and Transforming Merit Minister.

sentences.zh: 其後謝表不至，遂輟加恩。

translations.literal: Thereafter his letter of thanks did not arrive, and additional favors were therefore suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter his letter of thanks never arrived, and additional favors were therefore suspended.

sentences.zh: 昊旵卒，無子，以女昭聖主國事，遂爲其婿陳日煚所有。

translations.literal: Hao Yan died without a son; his daughter Zhao Sheng managed state affairs, and the kingdom thereafter fell into the hands of her son-in-law Chen Ri-jiong.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Yan died without a son. His daughter Zhao Sheng took charge of state affairs, and the kingdom thereafter passed into the hands of her son-in-law Chen Ri-jiong.

sentences.zh: 李氏有國，自公蘊至昊旵，凡八傳，二百二十餘年而國亡。

translations.literal: The Li clan held the kingdom from Gong Yun to Hao Yan—a total of eight generations and more than two hundred and twenty years—before the state perished.
translations.idiomatic: The Li clan had held the kingdom from Gong Yun to Hao Yan—eight generations in all and more than two hundred and twenty years—before the state perished.

sentences.zh: 淳祐二年，詔安南國王陳日煚，元賜效忠順化保節功臣增「守義」二字。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunyou, an edict addressed Chen Ri-jiong, King of Annam: to his originally granted title Loyal and Transforming Integrity-Preserving Merit Minister were added the two characters "Upholding Righteousness."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Chunyou reign an edict addressed Chen Ri-jiong, King of Annam, adding the two characters "Upholding Righteousness" to his originally granted title Loyal and Transforming Integrity-Preserving Merit Minister.

sentences.zh: 寶祐六年，詔安南情狀叵測，申飭邊備。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Baoyou, an edict stated that Annam's intentions were hard to fathom, and ordered heightened preparations along the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Baoyou reign an edict declared that Annam's intentions were impossible to read and ordered stricter preparations along the frontier.

sentences.zh: 景定二年，貢象二。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingding, two elephants were sent as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Jingding reign two elephants were sent as tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年，表乞世襲。

translations.literal: In the third year, a memorial was submitted requesting hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he submitted a memorial requesting hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 詔日煚授檢校太師、安南國大王，加食邑；

translations.literal: An edict appointed Ri-jiong Honorary Grand Preceptor and Grand King of Annam, with an increase in fief income;
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Ri-jiong Honorary Grand Preceptor and Grand King of Annam and increased his fief income;

sentences.zh: 男威晃，授靜海軍節度使、觀察處置使、檢校太尉兼御史大夫、上柱國、安南國王、效忠順化功臣，賜金帶、器幣、鞍馬。

translations.literal: His son Wei Huang was appointed Military Commissioner of the Jinghai Army, Commissioner for Observation and Disposition, Honorary Grand General concurrently Grand Censor, Upper Pillar of the State, King of Annam, and Loyal and Transforming Merit Minister, and was granted a gold belt, utensils, coins, and a saddle horse.
translations.idiomatic: His son Wei Huang was appointed Military Commissioner of the Jinghai Army, Commissioner for Observation and Disposition, Honorary Grand General and concurrent Grand Censor, Upper Pillar of the State, King of Annam, and Loyal and Transforming Merit Minister, and was granted a gold belt, utensils, coins, and a saddle horse.

sentences.zh: 咸淳五年，詔安南國王父日煚、國王威晃加食邑。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xianchun, an edict granted increases in fief income to Ri-jiong, father of the King of Annam, and to King Wei Huang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Xianchun reign an edict granted increases in fief income to Ri-jiong, father of the King of Annam, and to King Wei Huang.

sentences.zh: 八年，明堂禮成，日煚、威晃各加食邑，賜鞍馬等物。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, when the Bright Hall rites were completed, Ri-jiong and Wei Huang each received increases in fief income, and saddle horses and other gifts were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, after the Bright Hall rites were completed, Ri-jiong and Wei Huang each received increases in fief income, along with saddle horses and other gifts.

sentences.zh: 大理國，即唐南詔也。

translations.literal: The Kingdom of Dali was the Nanzhao of the Tang dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: The Kingdom of Dali was the Nanzhao of the Tang dynasty.

sentences.zh: 熙寧九年，遣使貢金裝碧玕山、氈罽、刀劍、犀皮甲鞍轡。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Xining, envoys were dispatched bearing tribute of gold-mounted azure jade mountains, felt rugs, swords, rhinoceros-hide armor, and saddle trappings.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of the Xining reign envoys were dispatched bearing tribute of gold-mounted azure jade mountains, felt rugs, swords, rhinoceros-hide armor, and saddle trappings.

sentences.zh: 自後不常來，亦不領於鴻臚。

translations.literal: After this they did not come regularly, nor were they received by the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: After this they did not come regularly, nor were they received by the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 政和五年，廣州觀察使黃璘奏，南詔大理國慕義懷徠，願爲臣妾，欲聽其入貢。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhenghe, Huang Lin, observation commissioner of Guangzhou, memorialized that Nanzhao-Dali admired righteousness and sought to draw near, wished to become a subject, and requested permission to send tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Zhenghe reign Huang Lin, observation commissioner of Guangzhou, memorialized that Nanzhao-Dali admired righteousness and sought to draw near, wished to become a subject, and asked permission to send tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔璘置局於賓州，凡有奏請，皆俟進止。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Lin to establish an office at Binzhou; all petitions were to await imperial direction.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Lin to establish an office at Binzhou; all petitions were to await imperial direction.

sentences.zh: 六年，遣進奉使天駟爽彥賁李紫琮、副使坦綽李伯祥來，詔璘与廣東轉運副使徐惕偕詣闕，其所經行，令監司一人主之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the tribute envoy Celestial Steed Shan Yanbin Li Zicong and vice-envoy Tan Chuo Li Boxiang were dispatched. An edict ordered Lin and Xu Ti, vice transport commissioner of Guangdong, to escort them to court; along the route, one supervising official was assigned to take charge at each stage.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the tribute envoy Celestial Steed Shan Yanbin Li Zicong and vice-envoy Tan Chuo Li Boxiang were dispatched. An edict ordered Lin and Xu Ti, vice transport commissioner of Guangdong, to escort them to court, with one supervising official assigned to take charge at each stage along the route.

sentences.zh: 道出荊湖南，當由邵州新化縣至鼎州，而璘家潭之湘鄉，轉運判官喬方欲媚璘，乃排比由邵至潭，由潭至鼎一路。

translations.literal: The route passed through southern Hunan and should have gone from Xinhua County in Shaozhou to Dingzhou, but Lin's home was in Xiangxiang in Tanzhou. Transport vice-commissioner Qiao Fang, wishing to ingratiate himself with Lin, instead arranged a route from Shao to Tan, and from Tan to Ding.
translations.idiomatic: The route passed through southern Hunan and should have run from Xinhua County in Shaozhou to Dingzhou, but Lin's home was in Xiangxiang in Tanzhou. Transport vice-commissioner Qiao Fang, wishing to curry favor with Lin, instead arranged a route from Shao to Tan and from Tan to Ding.

sentences.zh: 御史劾其當農事之際，而觀望勞民，詔罷方。

translations.literal: Censors impeached them for wasting labor among the people at the height of the farming season while dragging out the journey; an edict dismissed Fang.
translations.idiomatic: Censors impeached them for burdening the people with unnecessary labor at the height of the farming season while dragging out the journey; an edict dismissed Fang.

sentences.zh: 紫琮等過鼎，聞學校文物之盛，請於押伴，求詣學瞻拜宣聖像，邵守張察許之，遂往，遍謁見諸生。

translations.literal: When Zicong and the others passed through Ding, having heard of the flourishing schools and civil culture, they asked their escorts for leave to visit the academy and pay homage before the image of the Sage; Prefect Zhang Cha of Shao granted permission, and they went and paid respects to all the students.
translations.idiomatic: When Zicong and the others passed through Ding, having heard of the flourishing schools and civil culture, they asked their escorts for leave to visit the academy and pay homage before the image of the Sage. Prefect Zhang Cha of Shao granted permission, and they went and paid respects to all the students.

sentences.zh: 又乞觀御書閣，舉笏扣首。

translations.literal: They also requested to view the Imperial Calligraphy Pavilion, raised their tablets, and kowtowed.
translations.idiomatic: They also requested to view the Imperial Calligraphy Pavilion, raised their tablets, and kowtowed.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，至京師，貢馬三百八十匹及麝香、牛黃、細氈、碧玕山諸物。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year, they reached the capital and presented three hundred and eighty horses as tribute, along with musk, ox bezoar, fine felt, azure jade mountains, and other goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year they reached the capital and presented three hundred and eighty horses as tribute, along with musk, ox bezoar, fine felt, azure jade mountains, and other goods.

sentences.zh: 制以其王段和譽爲金紫光祿大夫、檢校司空、雲南節度使、上柱國、大理國王。

translations.literal: A decree appointed their king Duan Heyu Golden-purple Light Grandee, Honorary Minister of Works, Military Commissioner of Yunnan, Upper Pillar of the State, and King of Dali.
translations.idiomatic: A decree appointed their king Duan Heyu Golden-purple Light Grandee, Honorary Minister of Works, Military Commissioner of Yunnan, Upper Pillar of the State, and King of Dali.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以爲璘有功，並其子暉、昨皆遷官，少子𣆳爲閣門宣贊舍人。

translations.literal: The court deemed Lin meritorious; he and his sons Hui and Zuo were all promoted in rank, and his youngest son was made Gatekeeper Herald.
translations.idiomatic: The court deemed Lin meritorious; he and his sons Hui and Zuo were all promoted in rank, and his youngest son was made Gatekeeper Herald.

sentences.zh: 已而知桂州周璘詐冒，璘得罪。

translations.literal: It was later learned that Zhou Lin of Guizhou had committed fraud, and Huang Lin was punished.
translations.idiomatic: It was later learned that Zhou Lin of Guizhou had committed fraud, and Huang Lin was punished.

sentences.zh: 自是大理復不通於中國，間一至黎州互市。

translations.literal: From then on Dali again had no contact with the Middle Kingdom, occasionally reaching only as far as Lizhou for mutual trade.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Dali again had no contact with the Middle Kingdom, occasionally reaching only as far as Lizhou for mutual trade.

sentences.zh: 紹興三年十月，廣西奏，大理國求入貢及售馬，詔卻之，不欲以虛名勞民也。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year of Shaoxing, Guangxi reported that Dali sought to send tribute and sell horses; an edict refused, not wishing to burden the people for the sake of empty ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the third year of the Shaoxing reign Guangxi reported that Dali sought to send tribute and sell horses; an edict refused, not wishing to burden the people for the sake of empty ceremony.

sentences.zh: 朱勝非奏曰：「昔年大理入貢，言者深指其妄，黃璘由是獲罪。」

translations.literal: Zhu Shengfei memorialized: "In years past when Dali sent tribute, critics sharply denounced it as fraudulent, and Huang Lin was punished on that account."
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shengfei memorialized: "In years past when Dali sent tribute, critics sharply denounced it as fraudulent, and Huang Lin was punished on that account.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「遐方異域，何由得實，但仇當其馬價，則馬方至，用益騎兵，不爲無補也。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "How can one verify the truth about distant foreign lands? If we simply pay the full price for their horses, the horses will come—and using them to increase our cavalry is no small benefit."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "How can one verify the truth about distant foreign lands? If we simply pay the full price for their horses, the horses will come—and using them to strengthen our cavalry is no small benefit."

sentences.zh: 六年七月，廣西經略安撫司奏，大理復遣使奉表貢象、馬，詔經略司護送行在，優禮答之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year, the Guangxi pacification and comfort commission reported that Dali again dispatched envoys with a memorial, presenting elephants and horses; an edict ordered the pacification commission to escort them to the temporary capital and receive them with generous courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixth year the Guangxi pacification and comfort commission reported that Dali again dispatched envoys with a memorial, presenting elephants and horses; an edict ordered the pacification commission to escort them to the temporary capital and receive them with generous courtesy.

sentences.zh: 九月，翰林學士朱震上言，乞諭廣西帥臣，凡市馬當擇謹厚者任之，毋遣好功喜事之人，以啟邊釁。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Hanlin Academician Zhu Zhen memorialized, requesting that Guangxi frontier commanders be instructed that horse purchases should be entrusted only to men who are cautious and steady, and that no glory-seeking busybodies be sent, lest they provoke border incidents.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Hanlin Academician Zhu Zhen memorialized, requesting that Guangxi frontier commanders be instructed to entrust horse purchases only to men who are cautious and steady, and never to send glory-seeking busybodies who might provoke border incidents.

sentences.zh: 異時南北路通，則漸減廣西市馬之數，庶幾消患于未然。

translations.literal: When the northern and southern routes are open in future, the number of horses purchased in Guangxi should gradually be reduced, so that troubles may be extinguished before they arise.
translations.idiomatic: When the northern and southern routes are open in future, the number of horses purchased in Guangxi should gradually be reduced, so that troubles may be extinguished before they arise.

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved this.

sentences.zh: 淳熙二年十一月，知靜江府張┉申嚴保伍之禁，又以邕管戍兵不能千人，左、右江峒丁十余萬，每恃以爲藩蔽，其邕州提舉、巡檢官宜精其選，以撫峒丁。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the second year of Chunxi, Zhang Shi, prefect of Jingjiang, memorialized on strictly enforcing the mutual-responsibility system among households, and further stated that garrison troops in Yongguan numbered fewer than a thousand, while the cave households of the Left and Right Rivers numbered more than a hundred thousand and were relied upon as a bulwark; therefore the Yongzhou intendant and inspection officials should be carefully selected to pacify the cave households.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the second year of the Chunxi reign Zhang Shi, prefect of Jingjiang, memorialized on strictly enforcing the mutual-responsibility system among households. He further stated that garrison troops in Yongguan numbered fewer than a thousand, while the cave households of the Left and Right Rivers numbered more than a hundred thousand and were relied upon as a bulwark; therefore the Yongzhou intendant and inspection officials should be carefully selected to pacify the cave households.

sentences.zh: 欲制大理，當自邕管始云。

translations.literal: If one wishes to control Dali, one must begin with Yongguan—the memorial concluded.
translations.idiomatic: If one wishes to control Dali, one must begin with Yongguan, the memorial concluded.
